articles.title: Bitcoin layer-2s face a bear-market reality check
articles.snippet: Botanix's shutdown has raised an uncomfortable question for Bitcoin builders: Does the market actually want programmable BTC, or just a better way to borrow, lend and earn yield on it?

articles.title: Crypto PAC's $12 million Senate candidate, Barry Moore, wins Alabama GOP primary
articles.snippet: The Trump loyalist drew more crypto dollars than any candidate so far in this year's midterms, and the result marks a big win for the industry's political arm.

articles.title: Hyperliquid's $10B open interest coincides with growth in equity-linked markets: Talos
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid’s $10 billion open interest milestone shows growing demand for onchain equities and commodities trading with 24/7 accessibility, according to Talos.

articles.title: Bitcoin Slides as Fed Says It Will 'Deliver Price Stability' Under Kevin Warsh
articles.snippet: The first FOMC meeting under new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh produced the expected result, yet Bitcoin and other assets dipped.
